title: Choose roles and cloud models from the CLI and the dashboard picker
goal: `nerv models set <role> local MODEL | cloud haiku|sonnet|opus` and the settings picker list the same choices; the models report shows route and model per role
acceptance: Test first on the CLI parsing and the report; picker shows the three cloud models with prices per million tokens (Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Opus 5.5 $4/$20 in/out)
Plain and Eva wording, STYLE-GUIDE tokens, phone width; no backlog IDs in text
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
